headlines.title: Arsenal survive late Slavia scare for hard-fought win
headlines.description: Arsenal earn their third win from four in the Champions League as goals from Noni Madueke and Victor Gyokeres are too much for Slavia Prague, despite a valiant late fight from the hosts to get back into the game.

headlines.title: Raphinha scores twice as Barcelona beat Aston Villa
headlines.description: Barcelona end Aston Villa's perfect Champions League start with an enthralling win at the Spotify Nou Camp.

headlines.title: Emery takes positives, but Villa 'have work to do' to reach Barca level
headlines.description: Aston Villa boss Unai Emery says his team have "work to do" to reach Barcelona's level after a 3-0 Champions League defeat at the Nou Camp.
